Tiers: T0 phones (FXAA, plate lake), T1 desktop (MSAA 4, mirror lake LAKE_R12, half-size mirror target), T2. The user's words: "benerin pinggiran air di deket es itu kalo geser kamera kek low quality anti aliasing gitu, tapi dia aneh glitch gitu, make it smooth yaa" (the water edge near the ice looks like low-quality anti-aliasing when the camera moves, with a weird glitch; make it smooth) and today "priority benerin anti aliasing water yaa, ensure everything perfect". House rules: the user's words win; build nothing beyond the brief; look at your own images with the Read tool; report honestly; a number without a look is not evidence.

WHAT AA7 IS (lane /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Library/Caches/retrux-lanes/aa7/retrux-web, lab :5197; patch vs BASE: /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Documents/GitHub/retrux-hero-rnd/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa7/lead/aa7.patch, 6 files: HeroEngine.ts, shaders/chunks.ts, world/EnvEdge.ts, world/Water.ts, world/LakeMirror.ts, world/PlateEnvironment.ts). LEAD DECISIONS (binding)
  L1 G1 judged on MC32 / J48 vs the GT (the J32 -50 % target is unreachable even for the GT).
  L3 v3's rest-frame change under the floes is ACCEPTED (removes a rendering error, moves toward the 2x GT); every changed spot must look right at 1x (no new dark dashes, holes, bright columns).
  L4 J rule: J32 / J48 reductions at least the GT's minus 5 points; larger is fine without lag / smear / trail.
  L5 F1's band sharpening is intended (G4 vs the unblurred resolve ?envedge=0 on band px); required: no rim / outline at 1x and DPR 2, no visible sharpness pumping when the camera stops OR starts.
  L7 A-2 (TAA outliers at the governor's reduced render scales) judged by visibility at 1x.
  L8 G7 at ~+5 % in the real loop is accepted.
  L9 (new) G1 per box on fast / diag / reverse / leave: the front slab (FS) is judged against the 16-sample GT's own reduction: FS MC32 reduction >= min(40 %, GT's - 5 points). GT FS MC32 vs BASE (NEW masks): fast -25 %, diag -34 %, leave -33 %, reverse -20 % (lead's crawl: $SP/lead/gtfs/crawl_{fast,diag,leave}.txt; reverse from the AA6 pre-judge). FS MCE must not be worse than fixed AA3's, and the FS waterline must show no stepping at 1x / 2x. Every other box keeps the plain gate (>= 50 % slow / medium, >= 40 % fast paths).
  L10 (new) knee 1.0 with the glide (see above). Measure its effect: thin dark features vs BASE / GT (jgt2) and G1.
  G1 is measured on aa5a's bloom-free NEW coverage masks (capm.mjs: $SP/work5/aa5a/caps/<path>_mask); OLD-mask (cap.mjs) numbers are context only (they count non-waterline 'partial' px over slab tops, AA6 finding G-4).

GATES: G1 MC32 >= 50 % lower than BASE slow / medium, >= 40 % fast / diag / reverse / leave (per box AND total; L9 for FS), J rule L4; G1c glide (aa5a's glide.mjs, REL edge jerk vs GT): AA6 reached medium 0.2000 / slow 0.2159 at knee 0.5, AA5a F1 0.2225 / 0.2403; AA7 must stay at or below AA5a's and within ~2 % of AA6's; G2 no ghosting / trails / smear (fast sweeps, reversals, 3-frame flick, hold press / mid / release / re-press, pointer leaving, resize mid-motion, tab hidden -> visible, governor 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7, DPR 2; stepped AND real rAF with CDP mouse input); G3 texture >= 0.95 of BASE (L3 for rest); G4 per L5; G5 hero, sky, clouds unchanged; G6 no periodic flash (stepped + real loop); G7 cost (L8); G8 switches exact; G9 phones == BASE; G10 tsc clean, 0 console errors / warnings, DPR 1 and 2, resize, context loss, WebKit and Firefox boot + sweep, no first-motion hitch.

args.judge: ROLE: independent, adversarial FINAL JUDGE of AA7 (lab :5197) through one lens. Read-only: never edit any lane, never restart :5197, :5196 or :5182 (if one is down, say so and restart only that lab with the documented command). Time box 70 min. Folder: $SP/work7/<lens>; mirror evidence into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa7/judge-<lens>/. Compare AA7 with BASE, the GT and AA6 (:5196). Each finding: id (<lens initial>-n), severity (blocker / major / minor / nit), evidence (paths + numbers + the images you looked at), exact repro, suggested fix. pass = true only if no blocker, major or minor is open in your lens. Score 0-10 against the user's words (8.5 = ship bar). Look at every image you cite.

lenses.prompt: LENS = MOTION (the user's complaint itself). (1) G1 on ALL six paths, per box (FS, WR, DR, FF, FR, RS) and total, NEW masks, with L9 for FS on the fast paths and the L4 J rule; G1c (glide.mjs) on slow and medium vs AA6 / AA5a. (2) G2 on every event case of jcap (fastrev, flick, leavere, holdre, pump, gov, tab, resize, dpr2), AA7 vs AA6 vs BASE, stepped, plus one real-rAF run with CDP mouse input; strips around each event, looked at. (3) L5: no sharpness snap at motion START (stepcnt: band px changing > 4 / 8 / 16 lv at the first moving frames after a rest, a hand-over and a re-press: AA7 within ~2x of ?lkglide=0 per frame) and no pumping at STOP; no rim at 1x / DPR 2. (4) G6 flash, stepped and real loop. (5) First-motion hitch after load and after a long rest. (6) The look: x1 and x2 strips of the FS / WR / RS waterlines on reverse and fast, AA7 vs AA6 vs BASE vs GT - does the edge glide smoothly like the GT, without steps, crawl or glitch? Say plainly whether the user's complaint is solved.

LENS = ARTIFACTS / REFLECTION. (1) Pop scan (popscan / popnew, bloom-free masks) on slow, medium, fast, diag, reverse, leave, hold: AA7 vs FIX1 and vs AA6; look at the biggest new clusters at 1x and 4x. (2) Rest look (L3): AA7 vs AA6 vs FIX1 vs the 2x GT under every floe at 1x and 4-8x, including the AA6 spots R-1 (bottom-centre gap x915-1040 y740-766), R-2 (far-left dashes x50-185 y525-590), R-4 (column x317-324 y493-504) and the far-floe pale block (medium k48-64). (3) The hold: crest train, the rings' reflection near floes, release / re-press. (4) A-3 with L10: thin dark features (jgt2) AA7 vs AA6 (knee 0.5) vs BASE vs GT, medium and rest; any new over-brightening or halo from the knee at bright / dark edges (floe outlines, rocks, posts) at 1x and 4x? (5) A-2 at the governor's 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7 with the knee: visible at 1x? (6) G-3: the smaller pale block under the near far floe at render scale 0.7 (gov case k89-93, crop x90-190 y490-520): report its visibility at 1x (a separate investigator works on a fix; do not duplicate it). (7) G5 hero / sky / clouds vs AA6: only the knee's region may change; G3 texture.

LENS = PERF + ROBUSTNESS + CODE. (1) G7: real-loop cost of AA7 vs BASE (and vs AA6) while moving and at rest, interleaved A/B, >= 8 pairs, each pair at 1-min load < 10, with SLOT_BG=0. Take an EXCLUSIVE measurement window: write $SP/slot/.slot-conf.json = {"n":1,"loadMax":24,"bg":false,"until":"<now + 20 min, ISO>","why":"perfcode exclusive timing"}, queue with a '!' label, run the batch, then restore exactly {"n":3,"loadMax":30,"bg":false}. Report ms/frame (median, p95) and the ratio; L8 accepts ~+5 %, flag > +7 % as a finding. (2) G8 every switch exact (ident.mjs: final image, all targets, all programs, 20 moving frames): AA7 default vs AA7 ?mirrorcost=0 (targets + final identical); AA7 ?lkglide=0&mirrorcost=0 == AA6 ?lkglide=0; AA7 ?ffblock=0 vs AA6 ?ffblock=0 (only the knee may differ: prove it by setting AA6's uAAKnee live to 1.0 before the frames, or by a frame diff restricted to the resolve); all five off (?aaresolve=0&slabflash=0&lktaa=0&lkglide=0&ffblock=0&mirrorcost=0) == BASE T1; T2 all off == BASE T2; ?envlake=plate == BASE; T0 == BASE. (3) G9 phones (T0, mobile emulation 390x844 DPR 3) == BASE. (4) G10: tsc clean; 0 console errors / warnings on every run; DPR 1 and 2; resize mid-motion; WebGL context loss and restore; WebKit and Firefox boot + sweep (g10x.mjs --engine webkit|firefox), look at their frames; first-motion hitch. (5) Code review of aa7.patch (read every hunk): correctness of the start ramp (TAA_HEAD, tail reset on no-history frames), the v3 guard maths (LK_FFB, LK_FFBT, LK_FFBD0/1, LK_FFBL; NaN / divide-by-zero / out-of-range texture reads), the knee line (does anything else read aaKnee before it is set, and is the plate lake / T0 untouched?), AA5c's slim mirror materials and late sky (dispose, resize, uniform sharing, render order), lab-only params never active without ?debug, comments accurate. Every code finding needs a concrete failure scenario.

args.g3:

Time box 70 min. Lane: make your own clone first: cp -c -R /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Library/Caches/retrux-lanes/aa7 /Users/muhamadrifaldi/Library/Caches/retrux-lanes/aa7g3, serve it on :5198 (cd .../aa7g3/retrux-web && PORT=5198 nohup node hero-lab/serve.mjs --no-watch > log 2>&1 &). Never edit aa7 itself or any other lane. Folder $SP/work7/g3; mirror LOG + key images into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa7/g3/.
1. Reproduce: the gov case (jcap.mjs --case gov) and, if the lab supports it, a fixed render scale (?scale=0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9 in the URL) on medium (k48-64) and reverse; compare AA7 vs ?ffblock=0 vs BASE vs a GT. Look at the strips.
2. Find the cause (debug renders allowed in your lane): e.g. the guard's row bracketing / foot footprint / LK_FFBT assumes the full-scale half-size mirror target, so at reduced scale (coarser rows) the bracket misses.
3. Fix it ONLY in a way that is bit-identical at render scale 1.0: ident.mjs at scale 1 for AA7 default, ?ffblock=0, ?lkglide=0 and all-five-off must give the same final image and targets as AA7 (:5197); programs may differ only by your scale term. ?ffblock=0 must stay exact at every scale.
4. Prove the effect at 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7: the gov strip and popscan / popnew (bloom-free masks) at the fixed scales, no new pops, no new dark dashes, R-1 / R-2 spots unchanged; tsc clean; 0 console lines.
5. Write the patch vs AA7 (diff -u with --label a/retrux-web/<file> / b/retrux-web/<file>), apply-test it on a fresh clone of aa7, and report. ok = true only if 3 and 4 both hold; otherwise report the cause and why it is not fixable within the time box. Stop your :5198 lab at the end.
